correctness.rationale: The block Laplacian has four complete orthogonal eigenspace modules; their two nontrivial (n-1)-fold eigenvalues collide exactly at b=a under n>=3,a>0,b>=0. PBH tests are applied separately off resonance and on the whole merged E⊕E at resonance, yielding the if-and-only-if support rules. Counting touched pairs versus sidewise selections proves every enumerator coefficient, the minimum counts and probability laws. Analytical Poisson limits are standard limits of the exact formulas; a 2,167-check standalone exact finite-field verifier corroborated small integer cases but is not used for the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: A complete two-weight \(K_{n,n}\) PBH placement classification, all-size generating polynomial, and sharp same-support resonance are not implications of the inspected path/cycle controllability, distance-regular necessary/sufficient multi-leader bounds, or universal zero-forcing methods. The homogeneous graph and PBH facts are known and acknowledged. The nearest crown graph edge-metric result has coincident counting data at deletion but studies a different invariant and does not imply positive-matching-weight controllability. Searches cannot exclude unindexed equivalences; see risks. The \(n=3,b=0\) six-cycle corner is also prior-known and expressly excluded as an independent novelty claim.

value.rationale: The fixed positive-support K_{n,n} family undergoes a factor-two minimum-actuator jump at an exact matched/nonmatched conductance coincidence, demonstrating strong sensitivity of controllability to weights without a topology change. A complete set characterization, all-cardinality actuator polynomial and sharp missing-actuator reliability scales give structural design data rather than a one-off rank computation. The homogeneous endpoint, generic PBH, and zero-forcing bounds are identified as prior methods and not counted as novel.
